# scim — SCIM 2.0 provisioning

[All groups](README.md)

## scim discover

Read a SCIM 2.0 service provider's ServiceProviderConfig, ResourceTypes and Schemas, and summarise what it supports (patch, bulk, filter, sort, etag, authentication schemes).

MCP tool: `scim_discover`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--base-url` | string | SCIM base URL, e.g. https://example.com/scim/v2. **Required.** |
| `--scim-token` | string | Bearer token (prefer env IDPDBG_SCIM_TOKEN or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SCIM_TOKEN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--headers` | json | Extra request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization":"Basic ..."}. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## scim request

Send one SCIM request by hand (any method and path) and show the response. GET is read-only; POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE change data at the service provider.

MCP tool: `scim_request`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--base-url` | string | SCIM base URL, e.g. https://example.com/scim/v2. **Required.** |
| `--scim-token` | string | Bearer token (prefer env IDPDBG_SCIM_TOKEN or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SCIM_TOKEN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--headers` | json | Extra request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization":"Basic ..."}. |
| `--method` | string | HTTP method. Default `GET`. One of `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`. |
| `--path` | string | Path under the base URL, with any query, e.g. /Users?filter=userName eq "a@b.c". **Required.** |
| `--body` | json | JSON request body (CLI: @file). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## scim bulk

Send a SCIM Bulk request (RFC 7644 §3.7) and check every operation's result: status, location for creates, and bulkId echo (bulkId references let one operation use a resource another creates). Checks the advertised bulk limits first. This changes data.

MCP tool: `scim_bulk`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--base-url` | string | SCIM base URL, e.g. https://example.com/scim/v2. **Required.** |
| `--scim-token` | string | Bearer token (prefer env IDPDBG_SCIM_TOKEN or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SCIM_TOKEN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--headers` | json | Extra request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization":"Basic ..."}. |
| `--operations` | json | JSON array of bulk operations, e.g. [{"method":"POST","path":"/Users","bulkId":"u1","data":{...}},{"method":"POST","path":"/Groups","bulkId":"g1","data":{"displayName":"G","members":[{"value":"bulkId:u1"}]}}] (CLI: @file). **Required.** |
| `--fail-on-errors` | int | Stop after this many failed operations. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## scim scenario

Run a provisioning scenario against a SCIM service provider and check every step. user_lifecycle: create, read, filter, a duplicate userName and a user without userName (both must be refused), PATCH, PUT, deactivate, delete, confirm 404. group_lifecycle: create a user and a group, add and remove the membership, delete both. Creates real (clearly named, temporary) objects and removes them afterwards unless keep is set.

MCP tool: `scim_scenario`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--base-url` | string | SCIM base URL, e.g. https://example.com/scim/v2. **Required.** |
| `--scim-token` | string | Bearer token (prefer env IDPDBG_SCIM_TOKEN or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_SCIM_TOKEN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--headers` | json | Extra request headers as a JSON object, e.g. {"Authorization":"Basic ..."}. |
| `--scenario` | string | Which scenario to run. Default `user_lifecycle`. One of `user_lifecycle`, `group_lifecycle`. |
| `--user-name` | string | userName for the test user; default is a random idpdbg-xxxx address. |
| `--email-domain` | string | Domain for the generated userName. Default `example.com`. |
| `--keep` | bool | Leave the created objects in place instead of deleting them. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
